categories.main_business_segments: SinoDaan Co., Ltd. primarily operates in construction engineering project management consulting and technical services, focusing on engineering supervision, engineering consulting, and smart engineering management and software development. Its services cover engineering consultation, surveying, design, cost consulting, bidding agency, project management and construction agency, risk management, post-project evaluation, informatization, digitalization, and telecom value-added services. Key sectors include housing construction, municipal, communication, energy, and water conservancy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates advanced technologies such as IoT, 5G, BIM, AI, big data, and cloud computing into its service offerings. It has developed proprietary intelligent platforms and AI models (e.g., 'Dali AI' vertical large model) to enhance project management efficiency, safety, and quality control. It employs standardized project management systems certified by multiple ISO standards and actively participates in industry standard development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities, state-owned enterprises, and large corporations in sectors like telecommunications, energy, water conservancy, and urban infrastructure. Major clients include China Mobile, State Grid, and various regional government asset management companies. The company serves markets across multiple construction and engineering disciplines, including digital economy infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across China, covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It has established a dual-headquarters strategy with northern headquarters in Jinan and southern headquarters in Guangzhou, supported by 24 subsidiaries and over 60 branches to ensure local service and resource coordination.
categories.supply_chain_position: SinoDaan operates primarily in the midstream of the construction engineering supply chain, providing professional project management, supervision, consulting, and technical services. It acts as a service provider coordinating various stakeholders in construction projects rather than a direct manufacturer or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on digital transformation and smart engineering management, emphasizing the development of intelligent project management platforms and AI-driven solutions. It aims to expand its full-process consulting services, integrate emerging technologies, and enhance its capabilities in digital economy, smart cities, and renewable energy sectors. R&D projects include intelligent remote production command systems, digital control platforms, and AI-based safety and progress monitoring tools.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from engineering supervision, consulting, design, bidding agency, and project management contracts. The company uses a bidding-based project acquisition model and offers both full-process and segmented consulting services. It also earns income from software products and digital platforms related to smart engineering management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading professional technical service provider in China's engineering supervision and consulting industry, recognized for its comprehensive qualifications and technological innovation. It holds a strong market position with extensive industry certifications and awards, competing with other specialized engineering consulting and supervision firms in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SinoDaan reported revenues of approximately RMB 688 million, a slight decrease of 2.43% from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 49.35 million. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 1.3 billion and equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 374 million. Despite recent profit declines due to macroeconomic and market challenges, the company maintains stable operations and is actively pursuing strategic transformation and cost control to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SinoDaan emphasizes its integrated full-process engineering consulting services combined with advanced digital and intelligent management platforms, offering clients standardized, automated, and digitalized project management solutions. Its proprietary AI models and smart platforms significantly enhance efficiency, safety, and quality control, differentiating it through technological innovation and comprehensive service coverage across multiple engineering disciplines.
